description: Use this when the user wants to change how a site or one of its checks is watched: a site's name, interval, timeout or group; a content check's text, selector, page, kind, attribute, limits, description, severity or interval; a dependency's name, description, severity or interval, and a plain HTTP dependency's URL and expected text; a cron job's schedule, grace period, longest run, description or severity. Returns the settings now in force. Only the fields given change. Not for pausing (use set_monitor_paused), deleting (the dashboard does that), or a dependency's components (plan it again with plan_dependency). Each setting is documented at https://flarewarden.com/docs/monitors.

attribute.description: A content check's attribute to read, for attribute_check.

case_sensitive.description: Whether a content check matches case exactly.

check.description: One of the site's content checks, dependencies or cron jobs, by id or name; leave out to change the site itself.

expected_text.description: A plain HTTP dependency's text its answer must hold (or, with match, must not hold or match); an empty string stops checking it.

grace.description: A cron job's grace period in seconds.

group.description: A site's group; an empty string removes it.

interval.description: Seconds between checks (30, 60, 300, 600, 1800 or 3600, as the plan allows).

match.description: How expected_text is matched. Default contains.

max.description: A content check's highest value allowed, for numeric_range or element_count.

max_run.description: A cron job's longest normal run in seconds; 0 turns it off.

min.description: A content check's lowest value allowed, for numeric_range or element_count.

name.description: The site's new name, or with check, the check's.

schedule.description: A cron job's schedule: a cron expression (UTC), every N minutes, hours or days, or heartbeat.

site.description: The site, by id, name or part of its URL.

text.description: A content check's text or pattern.

timeout.description: Seconds a site's checks wait for an answer before they count as failed (5, 10, 15 or 30; 10 unless changed). A longer one lets a slow page pass.

url.description: A plain HTTP dependency's URL; a status page dependency is changed with plan_dependency.

name: update_monitor
title: Change a monitor's settings
